result.instructions: Tools for PerfectGym, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which classes run tomorrow at our Downtown club, and which still have free spots?"; "Find the member named Smith and show me their active contracts."; "Book member 42 into class 7 and tell me if the class is full.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes PerfectGym data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run perfectgym_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run perfectgym_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run perfectgym_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. perfectgym_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: perfectgym_list_clubs
tools.title: List clubs
tools.description: List the studio's clubs (locations) with name, address, and opening details. Good first call to get the clubId values used by other tools. OData: GET /v2.2/odata/Clubs.

tools.name: perfectgym_list_classes
tools.title: List classes
tools.description: List scheduled classes with start and end dates, capacity, attendee count, instructor and club. Use filter (for example "clubId eq 3") to narrow the schedule. OData: GET /v2.2/odata/Classes.

tools.name: perfectgym_get_class
tools.title: Get a class
tools.description: Get one scheduled class by id, including its attendee count and limit. OData: GET /v2.2/odata/Classes/{key}.

tools.name: perfectgym_list_class_bookings
tools.title: List class bookings
tools.description: List class bookings, including whether each one is a standby or canceled booking. Use filter (for example "classId eq 7" or "memberId eq 42"). OData: GET /v2.2/odata/ClassBookings.

tools.name: perfectgym_search_members
tools.title: Search members
tools.description: Search members with an OData filter, for example "contains(lastName,'Smith')" or "homeClubId eq 3". Returns contact, club and status fields. OData: GET /v2.2/odata/Members.

tools.name: perfectgym_get_member
tools.title: Get a member
tools.description: Get one member by id, including contracts, tags, notes and member balance. OData: GET /v2.2/odata/Members/{key}.

tools.name: perfectgym_list_contracts
tools.title: List contracts
tools.description: List membership contracts with status, start and end dates, club and payment plan. Use filter (for example "memberId eq 42"). OData: GET /v2.2/odata/Contracts.

tools.name: perfectgym_list_contract_payments
tools.title: List contract payments
tools.description: List payments made against contracts, with amounts and dates. Use filter (for example "contractId eq 9"). OData: GET /v2.2/odata/ContractPayments.

tools.name: perfectgym_get_contract_payment_schedule
tools.title: Get contract payment schedule
tools.description: Get the upcoming payment schedule for one contract. Read only. REST: GET /v2.2/Contracts/PaymentSchedule?ContractId={id}.

tools.name: perfectgym_list_membership_types
tools.title: List membership types
tools.description: List the membership types (products) the studio sells, with names and club availability. OData: GET /v2.2/odata/MembershipTypes.

tools.name: perfectgym_book_class
tools.title: Book a class for a member
tools.description: WRITE: book one class for one member. Changes the studio's bookings and may charge the member. REST: POST /v2.2/ClassBooking/BookClass.

book_despite_other_bookings.description: Book even when the member has another booking at the same time.

seat_number.description: Seat number, when the class allows seat choice.

annotations.title: Book a class for a member

tools.name: perfectgym_cancel_class_booking
tools.title: Cancel one class booking
tools.description: WRITE: cancel one class booking by its booking id. The member may lose the class and may be charged a late-cancellation fee. REST: POST /v2.2/ClassBooking/CancelSingleBooking.

do_not_charge_for_late_cancellation.description: Skip the late-cancellation charge for this cancellation.

tools.name: perfectgym_add_member_note
tools.title: Add a member note
tools.description: WRITE: add a note to a member's record. Notes are visible to staff. REST: POST /v2.2/Members/AddMemberNote.

is_pinned.description: Pin the note to the top of the member's record.

tools.name: perfectgym_add_lead
tools.title: Add a CRM lead
tools.description: WRITE: create a sales lead (prospect) in a club's CRM. Creates a new record in the studio. REST: POST /v2.2/Crm2/AddLead.

club_id.description: The club the lead belongs to (from perfectgym_list_clubs).

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with PerfectGym
prompts.description: What you can do with PerfectGym here, with example requests to try.
